race.comment: STRAWBERRY IMPACT (1) resumed last start with a close second over 1300m at Newcastle after coming from last on straightening. Has only won once in 18 runs but it did come here at today's trip. Frustrating five-year-old but this is a modest Class 1 so he will never get a better chance to double the tally. TIGER TURF (4) is the danger. Outclassed a fortnight ago in the Group 3 Spring Stakes at Newcastle. Recovered from a slow start to finish fourth here two back in a similar race to this. Can run a big race with a repeat of that effort. YES HE REIGNS (5) started at $1.75 and got the job done in style when fresh from a spell recently over 1200m at the Sapphire Coast. Big step up in grade today but he has only been to the races twice so there is plenty of upside. COCO DIOR (6) struggles at provincial level but this is not strong. Worth throwing in the exotics. SOUTHERN GRACE (7) flew home to win a super maiden at Gundagai recently. Should go well over more ground today.
